title: Available Integrations and Connectors
content:
Symbol-U integrates with your existing tools and workflows:

**Communication Platforms:**
- Slack: Full bot integration with slash commands
- Microsoft Teams: Native app with channel support
- Discord: Bot for community/developer use

**Knowledge Bases:**
- Confluence: Bidirectional sync
- Notion: Read-only connector
- SharePoint: Enterprise connector
- Google Drive: Document indexing

**Developer Tools:**
- GitHub: Issue and PR analysis
- Jira: Ticket integration
- Linear: Project sync
- VS Code: Extension available

**CRM/Support:**
- Salesforce: Case enrichment
- Zendesk: Ticket assistance
- Intercom: Chat enhancement
- HubSpot: Contact insights

**API Access:**
- REST API with OpenAPI spec
- GraphQL endpoint (beta)
- Webhooks for real-time events
- SDK available for Python, Node.js, Go

**Custom Integrations:**
Enterprise customers can request custom connectors. Typical build time is 2-4 weeks depending on complexity.
